subject: razor_static_link
definition: 主动技能或物品施放时，可以选择敌方单位为目标；允许同一技能或物品也能选择友方。指向方式不推断是否触发林肯格挡或莲花反弹，具体交互分别核对。
definition_note: U31：骨灰类是用户指出的例外。目标字段只证明指向方式；格挡和反弹不能相互推断，也不能从大部分推为全部。物品例子的目标方式来自现有社区快照；v1抽取器仍绑定旧词表，不在此自动重跑。；U33：可主动施放或开关的攻击类技能（连击、天界箭袋、影武长刀）也算，但用户报告它们不触发法术反制、清莲宝珠、林肯法球；U51：CUSTOM阵营看能否选敌方单位（残岩魔咒、血盆大口的敌方小兵、投掷到敌方都算）

context.description_en: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
context.description_zh: 在雷泽和敌方英雄之间创造静电连接，偷取目标的攻击力并转移给雷泽。雷泽在连接生效时可以边移动边攻击。
notes_en: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes %drain_range_buffer% units greater than Static Link's cast range.
notes_zh: 链接在一方单位死亡或双方距离超过%drain_range_buffer%后断裂。

context.description_en: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
context.description_zh: 拉比克钻研一个敌方英雄的魔法精华之痕，学习这个英雄最后释放的技能的秘密。拉比克将可以使用这个技能，维持几分钟或直到他死亡。
notes_en: Cannot steal item abilities.
Rubick will steal the Aghanim's Shard version of the ability, if he himself has an Aghanim's Shard.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
notes_zh: 无法窃取物品类技能。
拉比克若拥有阿哈利姆魔晶，则窃取的技能会是魔晶升级版本。
不会触发法术反弹。

scepter_loc.en: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.
scepter_loc.zh: 可窃取的技能提升至2个。提升施法距离，并且窃取的技能会升级成神杖版本。

shard_loc.en: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
shard_loc.zh: 窃取的技能升级为相应的魔晶版本。

context.description_en:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
净化目标敌方单位，移除增益魔法效果，并使目标在持续时间内减速。伤害在持续时间结束时计算，在此之前目标单位的移动速度缓慢地恢复。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净化的影响。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: The slow starts at %max_slow%%% and decreases over time to %min_slow%%%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.
notes_zh: 减速效果起始时为%max_slow%%%，然后持续减少至%min_slow%%%。
邪恶净化的持续时间内将持续移除目标的有益状态。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain %max_charges% charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 邪恶净化具有破坏效果，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。

context.description_zh: 将目标单位从战场上放逐一段时间。回归时会产生该单位的2个具有额外基础攻击力的幻象，受暗影恶魔控制。

context.description_en: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within %radius% range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.
context.description_zh: 只要目标受到伤害，目标附近%radius%范围内所有敌人，若目标为敌人那也包括目标自身，他们都将受到该伤害的一定百分比。可以对敌方或友方目标施放。敌人被崩裂禁锢隐藏时效果暂停。
notes_en: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

context.description_en: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
context.description_zh: 利用虚空能量制造出分叉的闪电，打击多个敌方单位。
notes_en: Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.
notes_zh: 最远可以伤害1000距离外的次级单位。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 使用魔法绑住一个敌方单位，使其无法攻击和移动，同时持续吸取他们的生命能量。

scepter_loc.en: Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离。被绑住的单位每%scepter_shock_interval%秒会释放一次辐射状的苍穹震击，作用于%scepter_shock_radius%范围内其他所有单位，造成伤害的数值为%scepter_shock_pct%%%苍穹震击普通伤害。另外还能使枷锁可以对暗影萨满附近%ally_break_range%范围内的友军和群蛇守卫施放。友方单位不会被控制。

context.description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，使其无法攻击和使用技能。
notes_en: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.
notes_zh: 立即摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

context.description_zh: 沉默术士用他的智慧强化刀刃，每次攻击窃取目标的智力，并造成基于他智力值的额外伤害。

shard_loc.en: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce %bounce_count% time to a random enemy within %bounce_range% range and increases intelligence steal.
shard_loc.zh: 使智慧之刃向%bounce_range% 范围内的随机敌人弹射%bounce_count%次，并提升智力窃取。

context.description_zh: 向目标施加魔咒，提供目标的视野，并且只要目标施放技能或魔咒消失，目标就会受到伤害并被沉默。根据沉默术士和目标的智力差还将造成额外伤害。
notes_en: Channeling abilities will trigger this effect once the caster finishes its channel.
notes_zh: 持续施法类技能在英雄结束施法后触发此技能的效果。

context.description_zh: 天怒法师利用上古符文将目标单位封印，目标单位将被沉默，受到魔法伤害时将承受额外伤害。
notes_en: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.
notes_zh: 减少魔法抗性的效果对非英雄单位无效。

scepter_loc.en: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
scepter_loc.zh: 天怒法师施放上古封印时，会随机对原目标附近%scepter_radius%范围内另一个敌人施放相同的技能。以英雄为首要目标。

context.description_zh: 天怒法师施放出缓慢移动的奥术鹰群，对敌方单位造成基于天怒法师智力值的伤害。
notes_en: The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
Arcane Bolt cannot be disjointed.
notes_zh: 鹰群移动得非常缓慢（500移速），提供325范围的视野。击中目标后，将给予目标区域的视野，持续3.34秒。
奥法鹰隼无法被躲避。

shard_loc.en: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, %total_bolt_count% bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within %extra_bolt_search_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.

冲刺指示特效仅对队友可见。
裂魂人将获得并共享目标的视野。

subject: tusk_snowball
definition: 主动技能或物品施放时，可以选择敌方单位为目标；允许同一技能或物品也能选择友方。指向方式不推断是否触发林肯格挡或莲花反弹，具体交互分别核对。
definition_note: U31：骨灰类是用户指出的例外。目标字段只证明指向方式；格挡和反弹不能相互推断，也不能从大部分推为全部。物品例子的目标方式来自现有社区快照；v1抽取器仍绑定旧词表，不在此自动重跑。；U33：可主动施放或开关的攻击类技能（连击、天界箭袋、影武长刀）也算，但用户报告它们不触发法术反制、清莲宝珠、林肯法球；U51：CUSTOM阵营看能否选敌方单位（残岩魔咒、血盆大口的敌方小兵、投掷到敌方都算）

context.description_en: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a %snowball_grab_radius% radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
context.description_zh: 巨牙海民开始卷成雪球。右键点击%snowball_grab_radius%范围内的友方英雄能使其加入雪球。发动雪球后，雪球经过的单位将会被眩晕并受到伤害。雪球每卷入一个英雄，它的伤害和眩晕时间都会得到提升。
notes_en: The snowball will break apart a maximum of 3 seconds after launch.
The snowball can be launched early by pressing using the Launch Snowball ability.
Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.
Allies can click on a snowball to add themselves to it.
notes_zh: 雪球在发动后经过最大3秒将会解体。
使用发动雪球技能就能提前发动雪球。
幻象不会进入雪球，但是米波的克隆体以及巨牙海民控制的其他单位将一同进入雪球。
米波的分身也能卷入雪球，并提升雪球的伤害。
队友可以点击雪球，使自己进入雪球。

context.description_en: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.
context.description_zh: 巨牙海民为他强力的海象神拳做好准备，下一次攻击将会造成额外伤害并暴击，同时将目标打到半空中。
notes_en: Walrus PUNCH has true strike.
notes_zh: 海象神拳！拥有克敌机先效果。

context.description_en: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
context.description_zh: 向一个敌方单位射出魔法箭，眩晕并造成伤害。

shard_loc.en: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within %bounce_range_pct%%% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.
shard_loc.zh: 可以对敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先，弹射距离为主目标的%bounce_range_pct%%%魔法箭施法距离内。

context.description_en: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
context.description_zh: 使一名敌人感染致命的瘟疫，施加时造成伤害，然后减速目标，并且基于目标的最大生命值造成持续伤害。不论负面状态以何种方式消失，瘟疫都会带着剧毒术士施加给初始目标的所有负面状态一起扩散到附近目标。第一次以外的额外扩散不会造成初始伤害。
notes_en: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.
notes_zh: 扩散的负面状态拥有固定的持续时间，不会受到状态抗性和负面状态增强的影响。

scepter_loc.en: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown% seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染的单位拥有的魔法抗性会降低。来自英雄目标的额外扩散会造成全额的击中伤害。
